title: GST composition scheme: a simple guide
summary: What the composition scheme is and what to check before you choose it.

sections.heading: What is the composition scheme?
paragraphs: The composition scheme is a simpler way for small businesses to pay GST.
Under it, you pay GST as a small fixed share of your sales. There is usually less paperwork than in the regular scheme.
